# Step - inject

`inject` · category: [Start](../../traversal/step_reference.md#start)

Inserts the given values into the stream (on g it starts a traversal with them).

## Forms

```text
inject()
inject(arg1: any)
inject(arg1: any, arg2: any)
inject(arg1, …, arg10)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject(1, 2, 3).sum().next()   // 6
```
